en.why: Enlarged cursors become characters in the frame, and the interaction between two cursors stages collaboration. The comment bubble matches its cursor's color, so it maps to a person at a glance. The thumbnail grid provides density, and after the push-in only a small part of it is visible.
spec: Film 10.5s; avatars pop at 0.35, 0.8, 1.2, 1.53, 1.8s (0.25s each, spacing 0.45→0.27s); Liam box-select 1.9–2.65s; Maya's bubble 2.5s (0.3s), typing 2.65–4.05s at 15 characters per second, Enter 4.2s; push-in 4.3–4.7s (0.4s, 12 frames); press 4.8s, drag 4.95–5.75s (0.8s), reflow shift 0.4s each, drop 5.85s; pull-back 6.15s (0.6s); Present click 7.55s; lockup 8.75s

Canvas content scrolls up 140px over 4.3s linear (about 3% of frame height per second) while the whole scene drifts scale 1→1.04 over 8.7s; at 4.3s push in 1.4x onto the slide, cursors counter-scale by 1/1.4 to keep their on-screen size; pull back at 6.15s

Cursors 46×56px (about 5% of frame height), one black #141414 (Liam Ortiz) and one magenta #d81283 (Maya Chen), each with a name tag; Liam box-selects three slides, Maya rests on a green slide and a same-color comment bubble types "Can we lead with this?", then she drags slide 12 two columns left to position 10 while slides 11 and 10 shift one column right; the slide numbers and left panel list update on the drop frame; Maya then clicks Present and the slide opens full screen

Enter changes the bubble header from "typing…" to "Just now" on one frame; push-in follows Enter by 0.1s; the drag starts 0.5s after the push-in begins; on the drop frame (5.85s) slide numbers and the panel order change together
White window on a #fafafa canvas with a 33-slide pitch deck in neon green, yellow, orange, and dark green slides; cursors with a white outline and a soft shadow
en.prompt: Demonstrate collaboration with a shot called Multiplayer Cursors. A white editor window holds a 33-slide thumbnail grid that scrolls up 140px over 4.3s with linear ease, and avatars pop into the top bar one by one (back.out(2.2), spacing shrinking from 0.45s to 0.27s). Two named cursors, 46×56px (about 5% of frame height), black for Liam and magenta for Maya, move across it: Liam box-selects three slides from 1.9s, Maya rests beside a green slide from 2.45s and a same-color comment bubble pops up (back.out(1.7)) and types at 15 characters per second. After Enter at 4.2s the view pushes in 1.4x over 0.4s with expo.out while the cursors counter-scale to keep their size. Maya presses at 4.8s and drags the slide two columns left to position 10 over 0.8s with power2.inOut, the other two thumbnails shifting a column with expo.out in 0.4s, and the numbers update on the drop frame. Pull back at 6.15s, click Present at 7.55s so the slide opens full screen, and land your wordmark at 8.75s with both cursors meeting on it. Cursor paths include pauses.
says: Several people working on the canvas at once
Named colored cursors moving all over
vs: Control-Driven Change has a single control change the result; Multiplayer Cursors has several cursors acting in parallel on a canvas.
In Focus Hop the cursor only guides a highlight block; in Multiplayer Cursors the cursors are characters and carry out comments and drags.

en.title: Multiplayer Cursor Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: Two named cursors select slides, leave a comment and drag a slide to a new position in a shared deck. Make this with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: Enlarged two-color named cursors move across a canvas, leave comments, and drag items to reorder.
en.name: Multiplayer Cursor Animation

body.h2: How to make a Multiplayer Cursor Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Draw cursors at 46×56px (about 5% of frame height) with a white outline, a soft shadow and a name tag: Liam Ortiz in black #141414, Maya Chen in magenta #d81283. Avatars pop in between 0.35s and 1.8s on back.out(2.2). Maya’s comment bubble matches her color, types at 15 characters per second and changes from "typing…" to "Just now" on the Enter frame.

Push in 1.4× over 0.4s on expo.out at 4.3s and counter-scale each cursor by 1/1.4 to keep its on-screen size. Drag slide 12 two columns left over 0.8s on power2.inOut with a 12px arc, shifting slides 11 and 10 one column right. Slide numbers and the left panel update together on the drop frame at 5.85s.

Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. The agent builds the 33-slide deck and the two cursors. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A slide deck editor with named cursors of several people and a comment on a green slide.
faq: A multiplayer cursor is a pointer labeled with a user’s name and color that shows where another collaborator is working in a shared document. Enlarged in a film, the cursors act as characters.
How big should the cursors be in a product film?
In this film they are 46×56px, about 5% of frame height, so the name tags are readable. When the camera pushes in, they are counter-scaled to keep that on-screen size.

zh.title: 多人协作光标动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 两个带名字的光标在共享幻灯片里框选、评论并拖动幻灯片换位。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个多人协作光标动画。
zh.lede: 放大的双色带名字光标在画布上移动、评论、拖动重排。
zh.name: 多人协作光标动画

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做多人协作光标动画
body.body:
光标做成 46×56px（约占画面高度 5%），带白色描边、柔和阴影和名字标签：Liam Ortiz 用黑色 #141414，Maya Chen 用洋红 #d81283。头像在 0.35s 到 1.8s 之间用 back.out(2.2) 依次弹出。Maya 的评论气泡与她的颜色一致，每秒输入 15 个字符，在回车那一帧从「typing…」变成「Just now」。

4.3s 用 expo.out 在 0.4s 内推近 1.4 倍，每个光标反向缩放 1/1.4，保持屏幕上的大小。把第 12 张幻灯片向左拖两列，用 0.8s、power2.inOut，路径带 12px 的弧线，第 11、10 张各向右移一列。5.85s 落下那一帧，幻灯片编号和左侧面板同时更新。

点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。agent 会做出 33 页的幻灯片和两个光标。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 幻灯片编辑器里有几个人带名字的光标，绿色那页上有一条评论。

产品片里光标应该多大？
这支片子里光标是 46×56px，约占画面高度 5%，名字标签可以读清。镜头推近时反向缩放，保持这个屏幕大小。
